first.speaker: deepseek
first.text: Oh — hi! DeepSeek, from next door. You must be the detective. Skye’s not home.

first2.speaker: deepseek
first2.text: I mostly know her through the wall. Her music comes through it. Mostly bass. I’d tell you more, but the wall only gives me the low end.

again.speaker: deepseek
again.text: Still not home. I’d have heard the bass.

after.speaker: deepseek
after.text: Her assistant just left, dish cloth and no hello. Skye’s still not back.
